comment: nexus-wbfpw.76. One shape table read by TWO tests that each exercise a real implementation: the engine's empty-tenant probe (ReaperRepository.holdsNothing, behind Rdr192BackfillGate; Rdr192EmptyTenantParityIntegrationTest) and the client rung's census (rdr192_manifest_backfill._default_census plus _cross_check_empty_listing; tests/upgrade/test_rdr192_empty_tenant_parity.py). The probe cannot be reached per tenant from Python (reaper.last_pass.tenants_empty is a machine-wide count over every tenant a pass visits), so the two sides are pinned to this table instead. The invariant is engine_empty implies client_census_clean: the engine may read stricter, never looser. A shape that changes either verdict fails the side that moved, and the Python test also checks the invariant over the table itself.
